# Leaflet 1.9.4 (vendored)

Self-hosted copy of Leaflet's `dist/` build (https://leafletjs.com), per
CLAUDE.md "Self-Host Everything". Used by the new UI's Explore map
(app/Ui). Source: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ — licence in LICENSE
(BSD-2-Clause).

To update: download the same files from the new version's `dist/` folder,
replace them here, and bump the version in this README.
